description: Evaluate 1 to 50 resumes against a job, criterion by criterion, and return them best first: for each, a score between 0 and 1, a verdict (highly_relevant, relevant, marginally_relevant or not_relevant), a summary, the required criteria missing or to verify, and the evidence for each criterion. Give the job as job_text (its criteria are extracted on the way, or pass your own criteria) or as the job_id of a stored job. Give each resume as text or as the application_id of a stored resume; at least one resume of the call holds 30 characters or more. Summaries and explanations are written in the job's language. With precise_ranking, the 10 best are re-ranked against each other, each with a ranking_reason. The result is decision support for a human recruiter, not an automated hiring decision. Costs 1 HireLayer credit per resume evaluated, and 1 more with precise_ranking; a pair already scored costs 0.

criteria.description: The job's own criteria, in the format extract_job_criteria returns; they replace the extraction. Only with job_text.

requirement.description: required: a resume that clearly lacks it loses 25 % of its score. preferred and bonus count through their weight only.

threshold.description: Minimum level in short text, such as 3 years or B2.

weight.description: 3 essential, 2 important, 1 nice to have, 0 off.

job_id.description: Alone: a job already stored, such as the job_id extract_job_criteria returned. With job_text: store the job under your own id; a new text or new criteria for a job already scored evaluate its stored scores again, 1 credit each.

job_text.description: The job description, at least 30 characters. Give job_text or job_id.

language.description: Language of the criteria, summaries and explanations: en, fr, de, es or pt. Only with job_text; defaults to the language of the job's text (English when it is another).

precise_ranking.description: Re-rank the 10 best against each other and explain each place in ranking_reason. 1 credit more for the call.

resumes.description: The resumes to score. Each needs text or application_id.

application_id.description: Alone: a resume already stored, such as the application_id parse_resume returned. With text: store the resume under your own id.

reference.description: Your label for this resume, returned as is.

workspace.description: The client company this call belongs to, when the user recruits for several companies: its HireLayer workspace id (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters), e.g. acme-corp. Jobs, resumes and scores stay apart from other clients'. A new id creates a new workspace, so reuse the exact id. Omit it for the user's default workspace.

name: score_resumes
title: Resume Scorer
